{{Quote|Stay close, Shadow Three, I'll have those droids cleared out in no time.''"<br />"''You got a chance, Shadow Five, as long as I'm covering you!|Shadow Five and Shadow Three, during the battle over Kadavo|<ref name="Slaves 6" />}}
"'''Shadow Three'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he participated in a [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|battle]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]], in which the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] planned to liberate [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], and a number of [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] who had all been [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] with close ties to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the battle, Shadow Three flew a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Confederate [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Something coming in fast&mdash;point ten-three!|Shadow Three, moments before being killed|<ref name="Slaves 6" />}}
One of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="Databank" /> the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] using the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "Shadow Three" was serving with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Slaves 6" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Kadavo date" /> Shadow [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] was dispatched to the planet [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]] as part of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] task force led by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Skywalker was planning to [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|liberate]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]&mdash;as well as the [[Mission to Zygerria/Legends|captured]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]]&mdash;who were being held inside a [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Labor Processing Hub]] on the surface of the planet.<ref name="Slaves 6" />

[[File:Shadow_Three_death.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Shadow Three's death]]
The Labor Processing Hub was owned and operated by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] slavers, who were allied with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Republic's enemy in the war. After arriving at Kadavo, Skywalker, his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and a number of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] landed on the surface and tried to break into the Labor Processing Hub, while the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] took position above the planet. Soon enough, however, Confederate [[Warship/Legends|warships]] also arrived at Kadavo with the aim of [[Death/Legends|killing]] the slaves and the Zygerrians alike. A [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] broke out between the two fleets over the planet, and Shadow Squadron, flying [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], engaged Confederate [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]].<ref name="Slaves 6" />

As Shadow Three and two more Shadow Squadron [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] attacked a group of enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]], [[Shadow Five]] told Shadow Three to stay close. Shadow Three provided cover for Shadow Five, and the clones successfully destroyed some of the enemy craft. However, the three pilots then fell under fire from Confederate [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]&mdash;flying her [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Trident (starship)/Legends|''Trident'']]&mdash;and a squadron of [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]]. Shadow Three was unable to evade enemy fire and was killed, along with his fellow pilots. Although Ventress broke through the Republic defenses and reached the planet, the Republic eventually won the battle and liberated the slaves.<ref name="Slaves 6" />

==Personality and traits==
Shadow Three had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], fair skin<ref name="Slaves 6" /> and, as a clone of Jango Fett, stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Databank" />

==Equipment==
During the battle over Kadavo, Shadow Three wore a clone trooper pilot uniform.<ref name="Slaves 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shadow Three appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars 6]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[Henry Gilroy]], illustrated by [[Scott Hepburn]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Slaves 6" /> on [[May 13]], [[2009]].<ref name="ReleaseDate">{{DarkHorse|url=comics/15-684/star-wars-the-clone-wars-6-of-6|text=STAR WARS: THE CLONE WARS #6 (OF 6)}}</ref> In [[2011]], the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Slaves of the Republic|''Slaves of the Republic'' story arc]] was adapted into three episodes of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]]. The TV adaptation featured a number of major differences from the comic books, however, which resulted in Shadow Three being omitted from the episodes.<ref name="TCW">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref>
